svg.title: A control: simulated households with a known share
svg.desc: Simulated mix of forward-looking households (consumption a random walk) and hand-to-mouth households with a share of 0.3 of income, 294 quarters, 1000 runs per case. Left: estimates of the share when past income predicts income growth (persistence 0.8); middle: when it barely does (persistence 0.3); right: how often Hall's test rejects at the 5 per cent level, how often the 95 per cent interval holds the true share, and how often the Anderson-Rubin set does. Educational demos made to show an open-source tool. Not research.
